verdicts.reason: A has a sensible banner split, with a large can on the left and the headline, subtitle and CTA on the right in a clear order. However, the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to a tiny mark wedged against the top edge of the panel, the subtitle runs to within about 30px of the right edge, and the offset dark panel starting at x≈228 looks arbitrary. B's oversized CTA pill competes with the headline and sits jammed under the subtitle. B's can is shrunk and pushed into the right third, where it straddles the panel's right edge, and that whole right side is dead space, so the layout feels lopsided and cramped on the left.
